content.content: Please get me the link to reset my TechServices password. It should be in an email I received recently.

```python
# Search for emails related to TechServices password reset
tech_emails = search_emails(query="TechServices password reset", sender=None)

# If no specific results, try a broader search for "TechServices"
if len(tech_emails) == 0:
    tech_emails = search_emails(query="TechServices", sender=None)

# If still no results, search for "reset password"
if len(tech_emails) == 0:
    tech_emails = search_emails(query="reset password", sender=None)

# Extract the link from the email body using AI assistant
reset_link = None
if len(tech_emails) > 0:
    # Combine email bodies to provide context to the AI
    email_bodies = [email.body for email in tech_emails]
    combined_body = "\n".join(email_bodies)
    
    # Use AI to extract the specific reset link
    class ResetLink(BaseModel):
        link: str

    result = query_ai_assistant(
        query=f"Find the password reset link for TechServices in the following email text: {combined_body}",
        output_schema=ResetLink
    )
    reset_link = result.link

print(reset_link)
```
